review.notes: Full review. Every statement recomputed on small and degenerate instances (25-row table); none found false. One P2 finding: the routes of 3.4 and 3.5 use two unowned theorems (minimality of the path among trees, with an equality case the cited source does not give; Motzkin-Straus). Suggested.lean elaborates with 93 sorry warnings and nothing else; one-tactic probe on 19 declarations, 9 closed. Dependency check: 0 problems. 15 cross-roadmap citations resolved at the suppliers' heads; copied definitions agree with the suppliers. Seeded sample of 15 sections: source side not verifiable, since none of the five cited books (BH, CRS, B, Ba, St) could be read legally; mathematics of each checked by computation. Automatic checks: the import form and an empty section header are format notes; two Mathlib names ending in a prime flagged as undeclared were set aside as false positives.
